title: The Weight of Water
setting_summary: In a cliffside settlement called the Cistern, a community survives by rationing water drawn from a single deep well, and every drop is measured by a rotating council that watches all. When a drought threatens the well and a stranger arrives claiming the right to drink without being counted, the settlement must decide what a person is worth when survival itself is rationed.
